snapshots.garbage_0:
Super Garbage Dealing System

I want to upgrade the garbage dealing system ,in the present,trash dealing systems dumped a lot of recyclable trash in landfills ,and need to transport garbage for a long distance,it could create polloution problems,most important of all,it is very expensive.

First,trash will go into a garbage sorting station ,it will sort trash into four types,which are:recyclable trash,burnable trash,wet trash,and other trash(landfill),so we can maximum the usage of trash.

The recycle center deal with all the recyclable trash,it melt metal into bars,plastic into new bottles and sell them to make money.

The trashes that have too much water will be sent to the dewater station to press out water so the volume of it can be minimized and can let it burn more efficiently.

Trashes that are dewatered or are dry enough will be sent into the burning system. It have a filter system that can filter out almost all smoke, and robots will change them when they get clogged. It can also create electricity to help cut down costs, and the toxic powders will be buried in the bury station.

The bury station have a lot of layers to prevent landfill leachate from leaking. it have concrete, High Density Polyethylene Geomembrance (plastic), Geosynthetic Clay Liner (clay). those are traditional materials, it also equips AI cameras and sensors to detect landfill lechate. Lechate being collected, will be pumped back to the landfill to create more methane gas and then collect them to create electricity to help cut down costs.

This is my super garbage dealing system, I hope it can make our city a more healthy and comfortable place.

snapshots.garbage_boundaries_corrected:
Super Garbage Dealing System

I want to upgrade the garbage dealing system. In the present, trash dealing systems dump a lot of recyclable trash in landfills. This could create polloution problems. Most important of all, it is very expensive.

First, trash will go into a garbage sorting station. It will sort trash into four types: recyclable trash, burnable trash, wet trash, and other trash (landfill). This can maximize the usage of trash.

The recycle center deals with all the recyclable trash. It melts metal into bars and plastic into new bottles, then sells them to make money.

The trashes that have too much water will be sent to the dewater station to press out water so the volume of it can be minimized and can let it burn more efficiently. And the waste water from this process will be sent to a water treatment plant.

Trashes that are dewatered or are dry enough will be sent into the burning system. It has a filter system that can filter out almost all smoke, and robots will change them when they get clogged. It can also create electricity to help cut down costs, and the toxic powders will be buried in the bury station.

The bury station will deal with other trash. It has a lot of layers to prevent landfill leachate from leaking. It has concrete, High Density Polyethylene Geomembrance (plastic), and Geosynthetic Clay Liner (clay). Those are traditional materials. It also equips AI cameras and sensors to detect landfill lechate. Lechate being collected will be pumped back to the landfill to create more methane gas, and then the system will collect the gas to create electricity to help cut down costs.

This is my super garbage dealing system. I hope it can make our city a more healthy and comfortable place.
snapshots.garbage_references_corrected:
Super Garbage Dealing System

I want to upgrade the garbage dealing system ,in the present,trash dealing systems dumped a lot of recyclable trash in landfills, it could create polloution problems,most important of all,it is very expensive.

First,trash will go into a garbage sorting station. It will sort trash into four types,which are:recyclable trash,burnable trash,wet trash,and other trash(landfill),so we can maximum the usage of trash.

The recycle center deals with all the recyclable trash. It melts metal into bars,plastic into new bottles and sells them to make money.

The trashes that have too much water will be sent to the dewater station to press out water. Removing the water minimizes the trash volume and lets the drier trash burn more efficiently. The waste water from this process will be sent to a water treatment plant.

Trashes that are dewatered or are dry enough will be sent into the burning system. It has a filter system that can filter out almost all smoke, and robots will change the filters when the filters get clogged. It can also create electricity to help cut down costs, and the toxic powders will be buried in the bury station.

The bury station will deal with other trash. It has a lot of layers to prevent landfill leachate from leaking. It has concrete, High Density Polyethylene Geomembrance (plastic), and Geosynthetic Clay Liner (clay). Those are traditional materials. The station also has AI cameras and sensors to detect landfill leachate. Pumps collect the leachate and return it to the landfill. The returned leachate helps create more methane gas. The system collects the methane and uses it to create electricity to help cut down costs.

This is my super garbage dealing system, I hope it can make our city a more healthy and comfortable place.

snapshots.narrative_initial:
The Clock on the Wall

Last Saturday, I tried to fix my grandma's old clock. I put the tiny gears on a towel, but then I kinda forgot where one went. "That is not great," I said.

Grandma laughed and asked me to look at the picture on the box. We found the empty spot together. The clock started ticking.
snapshots.narrative_revision:
The Clock on the Wall

Last Saturday, I tried to fix my grandma's old clock. I put the tiny gears on a towel, but then I kinda forgot where one went. "That is not great," I said.

Grandma laughed and asked me to look at the picture on the box. We found the empty spot together. I fitted the last gear into the empty spot and turned the small knob. The clock started ticking, and I felt like we had woken it up.
